verification_method: Read-only public Apify API metadata, default-build input schema and public LinkedIn company HTML. No paid run performed during this research.

actor.name: oski/linkedin-ad-library-scraper
actor.pricing_note: Estimate uses the highest published tier price and excludes any ancillary API/storage charges. Recheck pricing before paid runs; event prices can change.
actor.authentication: Send the token in the Authorization Bearer header, never in query strings.

input_semantics.companyIds: Numeric company IDs or numeric company URLs match an exact advertiser. Prefer these over name searches.
input_semantics.countries: Empty array includes all available countries. Nonempty array limits ads to those shown in the specified countries; names or country codes are accepted.
input_semantics.dateRange: Allowed values: all, last-30-days, current-month, current-year, last-year. A rolling range changes its actual start and end dates between runs.
input_semantics.startDate_endDate: Optional absolute or relative custom dates override dateRange. The provider states data can lag by one day.
input_semantics.maxAdsPerSearch: Input-side cap for each advertiser/company/keyword/search URL.
input_semantics.maxAds: Input-side cap for the whole run; zero means unlimited and should not be used for this project.
input_semantics.includeDetails: Required for full details. Disabling does not lower the documented per-ad price.

normalization_fields.details_status: ok or unavailable in documented output; treat missing/unknown statuses conservatively.
normalization_fields.landing_url: No dedicated landing-page URL exists in the documented sample. Only use concrete observed external URLs from returned links, and preserve the extraction source. A commentary link is a linked page, not necessarily the ad CTA destination.

coverage_cautions: A SUCCEEDED run does not prove that all ads were collected.
If the result count reaches maxAdsPerSearch or maxAds, mark collection as capped. Fewer results do not alone prove full coverage either.
An ad absent from a later partial, capped or failed scan must not be called stopped or removed.
Even with successful scans, ads can age out of the rolling date window or public library retention period.
Store the requested scope, Actor build, run ID, fetched timestamp and source links with each snapshot.
Fetch all dataset pages using offset/limit and X-Apify-Pagination-Total; dataset pagination completion is separate from upstream search completeness.
Only some ads disclose dates, impressions and targeting. Null is unknown, not zero or false.
Public copy can suggest audience messaging; it does not prove delivery targeting.
Do not infer spend, clicks, conversions, ROAS or ad performance from ad presence or impression ranges.

The documented dataset has no structured per-search success or total-found field. The run statusMessage may describe skipped searches, unrecognized countries or unavailable ads. Do not claim complete coverage from SUCCEEDED plus fewer than the cap alone.
actor.price_selection: Select the pricingInfos record with the latest startedAt that is not in the future. At verification, only one oski record exists; there is no advertised future pricing record.

alternative.name: ivanvs/linkedin-ad-library-scraper
alternative.schema_warning: Current build input uses maxRecords, despite the README example using maxResults.
alternative.normalization_difference: id/url; advertiser{name,url}; body/title/buttons; period{start,end}; paidBy; totalImpression; targetingSettings; targetingParameters.
alternative.selection_note: Longer public usage history than oski, but higher unit price and a README/schema mismatch. Retain as a separately tested fallback, never silently switch providers within a comparison series.

budget_controls.maxTotalChargeUsd: Apify run query parameter that caps total charge. Use for this pay-per-event Actor.
budget_controls.maxItems: The Apify run maxItems query parameter controls paid dataset items only for pay-per-result Actors; it is not the correct budget control for this pay-per-event Actor.
budget_controls.ambiguous_start: A lost response to the POST may still mean a run started. Reserve the maximum charge and do not blindly retry paid starts.
budget_controls.project_cap: Enforce the user-approved cumulative cap separately from each per-run cap, including pending and uncertain runs.
budget_controls.reported_spend: Authenticated run usageTotalUsd is the actual total charged for the run under its pricing model. Missing/null means unknown. eventUsage is a breakdown already included; do not add it again. Retain the full reservation independently if cost accounting is uncertain.
budget_controls.reported_event_breakdown: eventUsage[eventName].eventTotalUsd reports PPE event totals. chargedEventCounts reports charge counts. externalChargedTotalUsd concerns multi-tenant Standby and is not applicable.
